Global Atlantic Financial Group is a US life insurance and annuity company that sells retirement and life-insurance products to individuals and families through distribution partners, and also reinsures blocks of business for other insurers. It is based in the United States (Crunchbase lists Atlanta) and manages well over $100 billion of assets. KKR bought a majority stake in 2021 and the remaining stake in 2024. B2B2C model with little consumer brand awareness.

Heimstaden Bostad is one of Europe's largest residential landlords, owning and managing well over 150,000 apartments across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Czechia, Finland and Poland. Tenants are ordinary renters and revenue is rental income. Operating head office is in Malmo, Sweden (Crunchbase lists Umea) and it is part of the Heimstaden group controlled by Ivar Tollefsen, with large institutional investors such as Alecta and Heimstaden AB. Bonds listed; little consumer brand awareness beyond tenants.

Lumo Homes focuses on real estate investments in Finland, according to Crunchbase. It is based in Helsinki, Southern Finland, and is classed under real estate and real estate investment. Funding shown is about $3.0 billion, with the latest round in September 2026. Customers and revenue model are not stated in the input; it appears to be a property investment and housing business. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Occidental Petroleum (Oxy) is a Houston-based oil and gas producer with major operations in the Permian Basin, the Gulf of Mexico, the Middle East and North Africa, plus a chemicals business (OxyChem) and low-carbon ventures such as direct air capture. Customers are refiners, traders and industrial buyers, and revenue is commodity sales. Listed on the NYSE (OXY); Berkshire Hathaway is its largest shareholder, with a stake near 28%. Tens of billions in annual revenue; B2B with little consumer visibility, although it has sponsored sport in the past.

Securitas is a Swedish security services group, founded in 1934 and headquartered in Stockholm, with roughly 350,000 employees in about 45 countries. It provides guarding, electronic security, fire and safety, and risk-management services to corporate, retail, industrial and government clients, earning contract revenue of roughly SEK 150 billion a year. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (SECU B). Strong B2B brand in Europe and North America, but not a consumer brand.

Vattenfall is Sweden's state-owned energy company, one of Europe's largest power producers, with hydro, wind, nuclear, solar and heat businesses plus electricity distribution and retail. Customers are millions of households and businesses in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark and the UK. Headquartered in Solna near Stockholm, about 20,000 employees, revenue of well over SEK 200 billion. Wholly owned by the Swedish state. Well-known consumer-facing utility brand in Nordic and German markets, with a history of sports sponsorship.

Accelerate is described by Crunchbase as a growth-oriented platform for real asset investment. It is based in Plano, Texas, United States, and is classed under infrastructure and natural resources. Funding shown is about $1.86 billion, with the latest round in September 2026. Its customers, products and ownership are not stated in the input. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

ACCIONA is a Spanish infrastructure and renewable energy group headquartered in Madrid, founded in 1997 from the merger of Entrecanales y Tavora and Cubiertas. Its businesses include renewable power generation (wind, solar, hydro), construction and engineering, water treatment and desalination, and services, with operations in more than 20 countries and revenue of roughly EUR 18 billion. Customers are utilities, governments and corporates. Listed on the Madrid exchange (ANA); Entrecanales family is the controlling shareholder. It owns the Spanish ACCIONA Energia, and has sponsored the Spanish sailing and Formula E world.

Acres Commercial Realty is a US commercial mortgage real estate investment trust that originates and holds transitional loans on commercial properties such as multifamily, office and industrial assets. Customers are property owners and developers who borrow, and revenue is mainly loan interest income. Based in Westbury, New York, and listed on the NYSE (ACR). Externally managed, small by REIT standards, with no consumer brand awareness.

Adani Transmission, now renamed Adani Energy Solutions, is India's largest private power transmission and distribution company, part of the Adani Group founded by Gautam Adani. It operates thousands of circuit kilometres of high-voltage lines and electricity distribution in Mumbai, and is rolling out smart meters. Customers are state utilities and electricity consumers. Based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and listed on the NSE and BSE. B2B utility; the wider Adani group is highly visible in India.

Al Morjan Two Electricity is described by Crunchbase as a special purpose vehicle. It is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is classed under construction. Funding shown is SAR 9.69 million. It most likely exists to build and own a single power project, but customers and ownership are not stated in the input. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

APA Group is Australia's largest natural gas infrastructure business, owning and operating about 15,000 km of gas transmission pipelines, gas storage, gas-fired and renewable power plants, and electricity interconnectors. Customers are energy retailers, industrial users and utilities, paid on long-term capacity contracts. Headquartered in Sydney and listed on the ASX (APA) with a market value of roughly A$9 billion. B2B infrastructure company with low consumer brand awareness.

APi Group is a US-based provider of safety, specialty and industrial services, including fire protection, life safety systems, HVAC, elevator and escalator services, inspection and testing. Customers are commercial, industrial and public-sector building owners, paid through installation contracts and recurring service revenue. Operates in more than 20 countries with about 30,000 employees and revenue around $7 billion. Listed on the NYSE (APG). Headquarters is in New Brighton, Minnesota (Crunchbase shows Pennsylvania). B2B, no consumer visibility.

Aristocrat Technologies is the Sydney-based gaming company behind Aristocrat Leisure, the world's largest slot machine maker alongside IGT and Light and Wonder, with an Australian heritage dating to 1953. It makes casino electronic gaming machines and systems, and owns digital game studios (Product Madness, Big Fish, Plarium) that publish mobile titles such as Lightning Link and Cashman Casino. Customers are casino operators and mobile gamers. Listed on the ASX (ALL) with a market value above A$30 billion. Strong B2B name, growing consumer game reach.

Baseten is a San Francisco AI infrastructure startup, founded in 2019, that provides an inference platform for deploying and serving machine learning models in production for developers and enterprises. Revenue comes from usage-based compute and platform fees. Customers include AI-native startups and larger companies running generative AI models. It has raised large venture rounds from investors such as IVP, Spark and Greylock, with total funding of about $2.1 billion per Crunchbase. B2B developer brand with little public awareness.

Biren Technology is a Shanghai-based AI chip startup that designs high-performance general-purpose GPUs for AI training and inference in data centres, with its BR100 series. Customers are Chinese cloud, internet and enterprise AI buyers. Founded in 2019, it has raised about $1.7 billion in funding and faces US export-control constraints on advanced chip manufacturing. Listed in Hong Kong in early 2026. B2B semiconductor firm with no consumer brand awareness.

Brixmor Property Group is a US real estate investment trust that owns and operates open-air shopping centres, mostly grocery-anchored, with roughly 360 properties and about 64 million sq ft of space across the country. Tenants are retailers such as grocers, off-price chains and service operators, and revenue is rent. Headquartered in New York and listed on the NYSE (BRX), with a market value of roughly $8 billion. B2B landlord with low consumer brand awareness.

C6 Bank is a Brazilian digital bank launched in 2019 and based in Sao Paulo, offering current accounts, credit cards, loans, investments and insurance through a mobile app, plus a rewards programme, mainly to retail customers and small businesses. It has well over 30 million customers. JPMorgan took a 40% stake in 2021 and the rest is held by Carlos Wizard Martins and other founders. Growing consumer brand in Brazil, with notable sports and entertainment sponsorships, including as an F1 team partner.

Choice Properties REIT is Canada's largest real estate investment trust, owning and managing about 700 retail, industrial, office and residential properties, mostly grocery-anchored retail leased to Loblaw Companies. Revenue is rental income from tenants. Based in Toronto, Ontario, it is controlled by George Weston Limited and Loblaw, and is listed on the TSX (CHP.UN). B2B landlord; the Loblaw and No Frills brands are what consumers know.

Cirque du Soleil is a Canadian entertainment company founded in 1984 in Quebec, producing touring and resident live acrobatic shows such as O, Mystere, Kooza and Corteo in Las Vegas and around the world. Customers are ticket-buying audiences and corporate clients for events. Based in Montreal, with thousands of artists and staff. It restructured through bankruptcy in 2020 and passed to its lenders. Highly recognised consumer brand in much of the world.

Compass is a US residential real estate brokerage and technology platform, founded in 2012, whose agents buy and sell homes using its software for marketing, client management and listings. It earns commission on home sales and agreed in 2025 to combine with Anywhere Real Estate, owner of Coldwell Banker, Century 21 and Sotheby's International Realty. Headquartered in New York and listed on the NYSE (COMP). Strong B2C brand in affluent US markets.

Compass Diversified Holdings is a US holding company that acquires and manages small and mid-sized businesses, including consumer brands such as 5.11 tactical apparel, Lugano jewellery, BOA, Ergobaby and Arnold, and industrial brands. It earns from dividends and sales of subsidiaries. Based in Westport, Connecticut, listed on the NYSE (CODI), with several billion dollars of revenue. Subsidiary brands, rather than the holding company, carry consumer visibility.

DailyPay is a US financial technology company that lets employees access earned wages before payday through an employer-integrated app, using a model funded by employers and optional employee fees. Customers are large employers in retail, hospitality, healthcare and logistics, and their staff, with millions of users. Founded in 2015 and based in New York, it has raised well over $1 billion in equity and debt. B2B2C brand known among hourly workers.

Diriyah Company is the Saudi giga-project developer behind Diriyah, the historic Najdi heritage site on the edge of Riyadh, which includes At-Turaif (UNESCO World Heritage). It is developing a multibillion-dollar mixed-use destination with hotels, retail, cultural and residential space, owned by the Public Investment Fund. Customers will be visitors, residents, tenants and investors. Based in Riyadh. Hosted the Formula E in Diriyah and is a visible Saudi tourism and sports presence.

Disney Streaming, formerly BAMTech, was the Disney technology unit that powered streaming services such as Disney+, Hulu and ESPN+ and sold video technology to third parties. Based in New York, it was folded into Disney's wider media and entertainment organisation in the early 2020s. Customers are consumer subscribers and advertisers. Owned by Disney (NYSE: DIS). The streaming brands have enormous consumer visibility.

First Industrial Realty Trust is a US real estate investment trust that owns, develops and manages industrial and logistics properties, around 400 buildings of roughly 65 million sq ft, in major markets such as Southern California, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago. Tenants are logistics, e-commerce and manufacturing firms paying rent. Based in Chicago and listed on the NYSE (FR). B2B landlord with little consumer visibility.

First Solar is a US maker of thin-film cadmium telluride solar modules, one of the largest solar manufacturers outside China, with factories in the US, India, Vietnam and Malaysia. Customers are utility-scale solar developers and power producers, paid under multi-year supply contracts. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, and listed on Nasdaq (FSLR), with a market value of tens of billions of dollars. B2B with modest consumer brand awareness.

Fluidstack is a cloud provider of GPU compute for AI labs and enterprises, building and operating large AI data-centre clusters for customers such as Anthropic and Mistral AI. Founded in London in 2017 and now based in New York per Crunchbase, it has raised about $2.4 billion in funding. Revenue is from compute capacity contracts. B2B infrastructure, low consumer awareness.

Getty Realty is a US real estate investment trust that owns convenience and automotive retail properties, mainly gas stations and car washes leased to operators, with over 1,000 sites across around 40 states. Revenue is rent from tenants on triple-net leases, with Getty Petroleum Marketing a legacy tenant relationship. Based in Jericho, New York and listed on the NYSE (GTY). B2B landlord with low consumer brand awareness.

Global Technical Realty provides build-to-suit data centres and technical real estate for hyperscalers and AI customers. Based in London, England, it is classed under data centres and information technology and has raised about $1.9 billion. Customers are cloud and AI providers leasing capacity, and revenue is rent and services. B2B infrastructure with no consumer visibility.

Helios Towers is an independent telecoms tower company operating about 15,000 towers across Africa and the Middle East in countries including Tanzania, DRC, Ghana, Congo, South Africa, Malawi, Madagascar, Senegal and Oman. Customers are mobile network operators such as Vodafone, Airtel, Orange and MTN, on long-term lease contracts. Headquartered in London and listed on the London Stock Exchange (HTWS), with a market value of about 1.5 billion pounds. B2B, little consumer awareness.

HomeServe USA is the US arm of UK-listed HomeServe, selling home emergency repair plans to homeowners, covering plumbing, water and sewer lines, electrical and HVAC, often marketed in partnership with utilities and municipalities. It earns subscription fees and has millions of customers. Based in Norwalk, Connecticut. HomeServe plc was acquired by Brookfield Asset Management in 2025 after leaving the LSE. Consumer-facing through utility co-branding, with direct-mail visibility.

Howard Hughes Holdings is a US developer and owner of master planned communities and mixed-use real estate, including Summerlin near Las Vegas, The Woodlands, Bridgeland and Teravalis in Texas and Arizona, Ward Village in Honolulu, and Seaport in New York, plus Vantage Pinnacle insurance operations since 2023. Customers are homebuyers, builders, tenants and visitors. Based in The Woodlands, Texas, listed on the NYSE (HHH), with Bill Ackman's Pershing Square as the major shareholder.

Huawei is the Chinese telecoms and technology giant founded in 1987 by Ren Zhengfei and based in Shenzhen. It makes mobile networks equipment, smartphones, laptops, wearables, cloud and AI services, Ascend AI chips, HarmonyOS and increasingly smart-car solutions, with revenue above 700 billion yuan and around 200,000 staff in 170 countries. Employee-owned and unlisted. Customers are carriers, enterprises, governments and consumers. Very high consumer brand awareness; US restrictions limit some markets.

JLL Income Property Trust is a non-traded US real estate investment trust sponsored by JLL, owning a diversified portfolio of industrial, apartment, office and retail properties plus some real estate debt. It raises capital from retail investors through financial advisers and earns rent and fund income. Based in Chicago with several billion dollars of assets. Low brand awareness among consumers beyond JLL itself.

Mid-America Apartment Communities (MAA) is a US real estate investment trust that owns and operates about 100,000 apartment homes across the Sunbelt, in markets including Atlanta, Dallas, Austin, Charlotte, Tampa and Phoenix. Residents are renters paying monthly rent. Headquartered in Germantown, Tennessee and listed on the NYSE (MAA), with a market value of around $17 billion. Residential landlord with local, rather than national, brand recognition.

Merritt Properties is a Baltimore-based commercial real estate firm that develops, owns and manages office, flex and warehouse properties across the Mid-Atlantic, principally in the Baltimore and Washington, DC, area. Customers are small and mid-sized business tenants paying rent. Privately held and founded in the 1970s by Alan Merritt. Local B2B brand with low national awareness.

Metro Loft Management is a New York-based vertically integrated real estate firm that acquires, develops and manages residential properties, principally multifamily rentals, in the New York metro area and other US cities. Customers are tenants and institutional investors, and it earns rent and management fees. Privately held. Limited consumer brand awareness beyond local renters.

Mileway is a pan-European owner of last-mile logistics real estate, with several thousand assets across the UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy and Spain. Customers are logistics, e-commerce and retail occupiers renting urban warehouses, and revenue is rent. Formed in 2021 as an institutionally backed platform and based in London. B2B landlord, no consumer visibility.

NETSTREIT is a US net lease REIT that owns single-tenant retail properties leased to e-commerce-resistant retailers such as pharmacies, dollar stores, auto parts and convenience stores, with several hundred properties across the US. Revenue is long-term triple-net rent. Based in Dallas, Texas, and listed on the NYSE (NTST) since 2020. B2B landlord with no consumer brand profile.

Noble Corporation is an offshore drilling contractor that rents out drillships and jackups to oil and gas companies worldwide, including Gulf of Mexico, Brazil, North Sea and the Middle East. Revenue is day-rate contracts, and it acquired Diamond Offshore in 2024. Customers are oil majors and national oil companies. Listed on the NYSE (NE); registered in the UK, with its operational base in Sugar Land, Texas, and a Houston link per Crunchbase. B2B with no consumer visibility.

Northern Indiana Public Service Company (NIPSCO) is a regulated utility serving gas and electricity to roughly 500,000 electric and 800,000 gas customers in northern Indiana, as a subsidiary of NiSource (NYSE: NI). Revenue is regulated tariffs from households, businesses and industrial users including steel mills. Based in Merrillville, Indiana, with a plan to retire coal and add renewables. Local utility brand.

Nutanix is a US hybrid multicloud software company that sells hyperconverged infrastructure and a cloud platform that runs virtual machines and applications across data centres and public clouds. Customers are large enterprises, governments and service providers, with revenue from subscriptions of about $2.5 billion a year. Founded in 2009, based in San Jose, California, and listed on Nasdaq (NTNX). B2B tech brand, benefitting from customers leaving VMware.

Omniyat is a Dubai luxury real estate developer, founded in 2005 by Mahdi Amjad, known for high-end towers in Business Bay and Downtown Dubai such as The Opus (designed by Zaha Hadid), One Palm, Dorchester Collection residences and Langham. Customers are high-net-worth buyers and investors in Dubai, and revenue comes from property sales. Privately held. Premium brand in the Gulf property market with a luxury-lifestyle profile.

Paycom is a US provider of cloud-based payroll and human capital management software, covering payroll, talent, time and labour management and HR on a single database. Customers are US employers, mostly mid-sized businesses with 50 to 5,000 employees, paying per-employee subscription fees, and revenue is about $2 billion. Founded in 2006 and based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, listed on the NYSE (PAYC). B2B, sponsors the Oklahoma City Thunder arena naming (Paycom Center) and has US sports visibility.

Phillips Edison & Company is a US REIT that owns and operates grocery-anchored neighbourhood shopping centres, around 300 centres of about 34 million sq ft in 30 states, anchored by Kroger, Publix and Albertsons. Revenue is rent from grocers and service retailers. Based in Cincinnati, Ohio, and listed on Nasdaq (PECO) since 2021. B2B landlord with little consumer awareness.

Quintain Estates & Development is a UK property developer and investor best known for Wembley Park in north London, where it has built thousands of build-to-rent homes (Tipi, Wembley Park brand), student housing, offices and retail near Wembley Stadium. It was acquired by Lone Star Funds in 2015 and is based in London. Revenue is rents and sales. Wembley Park is a recognised London destination brand.

SambaNova is a US AI hardware and software company, founded in 2017 in Palo Alto and based in San Jose, California, that sells reconfigurable dataflow chips (SN40L) and a full-stack platform and cloud service for running large AI models, with a focus on fast inference. Customers are enterprises, governments and national labs. It has raised about $1.1 billion from SoftBank, Intel Capital and others, with total shown near $2.5 billion. B2B with limited public awareness.

Service Properties Trust is a US REIT that owns hotels (about 200 managed by operators such as Sonesta, Hyatt, IHG and Radisson) and net lease service-oriented retail properties such as travel centres leased to TravelCenters of America. Revenue is hotel operating revenue and rents. Managed by RMR Group and based in Newton, Massachusetts; listed on Nasdaq (SVC). B2B landlord with no consumer brand awareness of its own.

Sharon AI is an Australian AI infrastructure company providing GPU cloud capacity for traditional AI and generative AI workloads, with data-centre capacity in the US. It is based in Sydney and listed on Nasdaq under a US ticker after a 2024 combination with Roth CH Acquisition V. Customers are AI developers and enterprises that rent compute. B2B with low consumer awareness.

Sika is a Swiss specialty chemicals company founded in 1910 in Baar, Zug, that makes construction chemicals and industrial products: sealants, adhesives, waterproofing, concrete admixtures, roofing and automotive bonding materials. Customers are builders, contractors and car and industrial manufacturers in more than 100 countries, with sales above CHF 11 billion and around 34,000 employees. Listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (SIKA). Strong B2B brand, with consumer exposure through DIY stores and motorsport partnerships.

Solor Bioenergi is a Swedish company in biofuel and renewable energy, involved in the production and distribution of wood pellets, briquettes and other biomass for heating. Based in Stockholm, it supplies power and district heating plants and industry. Funding shown is SEK 22 million. Privately held, with small scale and limited consumer awareness.

Soloviev Group is a New York-based real estate development company founded by Sergey Soloviev that is focused on luxury residential and mixed-use projects in the US and internationally, including Moscow-origin and Miami developments. Revenue is property sales and development fees. Privately held, with a modest public profile outside the property industry.

Spirit AeroSystems is a US maker of aerostructures, such as fuselages, wings and pylons, supplying Boeing (the 737 fuselage and many others) and Airbus, with sites in Wichita, Oklahoma, North Carolina, UK, France and Malaysia. Revenue is long-term supply contracts of about $6 billion a year. Boeing agreed to buy most of it in 2024; the deal closed in late 2025, with the Airbus work sold off to Airbus. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

Veris Residential is a US REIT owning luxury waterfront multifamily apartments and some retail, mainly in Jersey City and Hoboken, New Jersey, and in Boston and Washington. Residents are renters, and revenue is rent. Listed on the NYSE (VRE), formerly Mack-Cali Realty, which refocused from offices to residential from 2020. Based in Jersey City. Local landlord brand.

Vesta is a Mexican industrial real estate company that develops, owns and leases industrial buildings and distribution centres, primarily in manufacturing hubs such as Bajio, Monterrey, Tijuana and Mexico City, for nearshoring-linked tenants like automotive and electronics manufacturers. Revenue is rent in US dollars. Headquartered in Mexico City and listed on the Mexican exchange (VESTA) and NYSE. B2B with no consumer awareness.

VGP is a Belgian-founded developer and owner of high-quality logistics and semi-industrial real estate in Europe, headquartered in Antwerp, with parks in Germany, Czechia, Spain, the Netherlands, France, Slovakia, Hungary and Romania. Customers include Amazon, DHL and Lidl as tenants, and revenue comes from rent and development gains, with a joint venture with Allianz. Listed on Euronext Brussels (VGP). B2B with no consumer awareness.

Corgi Insurance is shown with Artificial Intelligence as its industry, and the Crunchbase text read from the recording is corrupted and mentions other firms. It has raised about $438.5 million. Location is not given. The input does not support more detail about its products or customers. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Abra Group is a Latin American airline holding company formed in 2022 that combines Avianca (Colombia) and GOL (Brazil), with Crunchbase listing it in Miami, Florida. It operates a combined fleet of several hundred aircraft and carries tens of millions of passengers a year, earning ticket, cargo and loyalty revenue. Backed by Synergy Group and Indigo Partners. Airline brands are consumer-facing and widely known in the region.

AIA Group is the largest Asia-Pacific-focused life insurer, founded in Shanghai in 1919 and based in Hong Kong, selling life, health, accident and retirement products to individual and corporate customers in 18 markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, China and India, mainly through agents and banks. It has over 40 million customers and a market value above US$80 billion. Listed on the Hong Kong exchange (1299). Strong consumer brand in Asia, with sponsorship of sports such as the Premier League (Tottenham) and rugby.

Al Dur Power and Water Company owns the Al Dur independent water and power plant in Bahrain, a gas-fired combined-cycle facility with desalination capacity that sells electricity and water to Bahrain's state utility under long-term contract. It is based in Manama and is a project company, with foreign shareholders including Suez and Marubeni. B2B infrastructure with no public brand awareness.

Amarenco is an Irish and French renewable energy developer and operator focused on solar PV, building and managing solar farms and rooftop and ground-mounted installations in France, Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Chile and Australia. Customers are utilities and corporate power buyers through PPAs. Based in Cork, with major investors including Ardian-linked and Brookfield funds. B2B with little consumer awareness.

Amp Solar Group is a Canadian developer of solar and other renewable energy projects, with operating assets and development pipeline in Canada and other markets, also known for its Amp Energy brand. Customers are utilities and commercial power buyers via power purchase agreements. Based in Port Credit, Ontario. B2B with limited public awareness.

Athora is a Bermuda-registered European life insurance and pension savings group, owned by funds linked to Apollo, writing savings, pension and annuity products. It has grown through acquisitions in Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Italy and, from 2025, the UK. Funding shown is about 1.2 billion euros. Customers are policyholders and pension schemes via local brands. B2B2C with limited brand awareness.

Azure Power is an Indian independent solar power producer that builds, owns and operates utility-scale and rooftop solar plants and sells electricity to government-owned utilities and corporates under long-term contracts. Based in New Delhi, with a few gigawatts of capacity. It was listed on the NYSE and later delisted, with the Canadian pension investor CDPQ as a major shareholder. B2B with low consumer awareness.

Ballard Power Systems is a Canadian fuel cell company, based in Burnaby, British Columbia, that makes proton exchange membrane hydrogen fuel cell stacks and modules for buses, trucks, rail, marine and stationary power. Customers include bus makers such as Wrightbus, and Solaris and rail companies like Alstom and Siemens. Revenue is about $100 million a year with losses. Listed on Nasdaq (BLDP) and the TSX. B2B with little consumer visibility.

Bank Polska Kasa Opieki, known as Bank Pekao, is Poland's second-largest bank by assets, selling retail, SME and corporate banking, investment and insurance products through around 800 branches, with millions of customers. Headquartered in Warsaw and listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (PEO). Controlled by insurer PZU and the Polish state. Mass-market consumer bank with high Polish visibility and a history of sports sponsorship.

Banque Misr is one of Egypt's largest state-owned banks, founded in 1920 by Talaat Harb. It offers retail, corporate and SME banking, digital banking and financing across several hundred branches in Egypt, plus a few international offices. Headquartered in Cairo and owned by the Egyptian government. Millions of customers and well-known across Egypt, with sponsorship of the Egyptian national teams.

BKV Corporation is a US natural gas producer focused on the Barnett Shale in Texas and the Marcellus in Pennsylvania, with power generation and carbon capture projects. It sells gas to utilities and marketers. Headquartered in Denver per its filings, though Crunchbase lists Atlanta; IPO'd on the NYSE (BKV) in 2024. Mid-sized exploration and production company, B2B with no consumer brand.

Blue Racer Midstream is a US midstream company that gathers, processes and fractionates natural gas and natural gas liquids in the Utica Shale in Ohio and West Virginia, serving producers. Revenue is fee-based. Based in Cambridge, Ohio, and formed as a joint venture involving Dominion Energy and Caiman Energy. B2B with no consumer awareness.

Carta is a US equity management and fund administration platform, founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, that handles cap tables, 409A valuations, employee equity plans, and venture fund and portfolio reporting for startups, investors and private companies. Customers are tens of thousands of private companies and funds, paying subscription fees. Valued near $7 billion in 2021. Well known in startup circles but not to consumers.

CNNC Huineng is the clean-energy arm of China National Nuclear Corporation, focused on developing, building and operating wind, solar and other renewable energy projects. It is based in Beijing (Fengtai) and is a state-owned subsidiary. Funding shown is about 8.29 million yuan. Customers are grid companies. B2B state-owned business with no consumer visibility.

Commercial International Bank (CIB) is Egypt's largest private-sector bank, offering corporate, SME and retail banking, cards, wealth and digital services across more than 200 branches, with millions of customers. Headquartered in Cairo, listed on the Egyptian Exchange (COMI) and with GDRs in London. A leading Egyptian financial brand with strong consumer and corporate recognition.

Development Bank of Kazakhstan is a state-owned development finance institution, set up in 2001 under the Baiterek holding, that funds infrastructure, industry and processing projects with long-term loans, guarantees and project finance. Customers are large Kazakh companies and foreign investors. Crunchbase lists its address in Astana. Owned by the Kazakh government, B2B and with no consumer profile.

DTE Gas Company is the Michigan natural gas utility that buys, stores, transmits and distributes natural gas to about 1.3 million residential, commercial and industrial customers, and is a subsidiary of DTE Energy (NYSE: DTE). Revenue is regulated tariffs. Based in Detroit area. Local utility brand with the parent being a well-known Michigan energy company.

EDP (Energias de Portugal) is a Portuguese integrated energy company and one of the world's largest renewables operators through EDP Renovaveis (EDPR), with hydro, wind, solar and grid businesses in Portugal, Spain, Brazil and the US. It serves millions of electricity and gas customers and has around 13,000 employees, with revenue near 16 billion euros. Headquartered in Lisbon and listed on Euronext Lisbon (EDP). China Three Gorges is its largest shareholder. Recognised consumer utility brand in Iberia, a sponsor of Portuguese and European sport.

Energo-Pro is a Czech-headquartered hydropower operator and electricity distributor, owning hydropower plants and distribution networks in Georgia, Bulgaria and Turkey. Customers are retail electricity users and businesses buying power. Based in Prague and privately owned by Czech businessman Jiri Krusina's group. Regional B2B and utility brand with limited broader awareness.

ENTEK is a US maker of lithium-ion battery separators, used in electric vehicles and energy storage, and has been building a new factory in Terre Haute, Indiana, with a US government loan. Customers are battery makers. Based in Lebanon, Oregon, and privately owned by Arbor Investments. B2B supplier with no consumer visibility.

EPIC is a US energy holding company engaged in the transportation, storage and processing of crude oil, natural gas liquids and refined products, with pipelines in Texas. It is based in San Antonio, Texas, and it is privately owned by investors including funds linked to Ares. Customers are producers and refiners. B2B with no consumer awareness.

Eurohold Bulgaria is a Bulgarian holding company in insurance, leasing and asset management, and owner of a sizeable energy distribution business in Bulgaria, having bought Czech CEZ's Bulgarian assets in 2021. Its Euroins insurer operates in Bulgaria, Romania, Greece and several nearby markets. Listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (EUBG) and based in Sofia. Euroins is widely known in Bulgaria.

Frontline is a shipping company, based in Oslo (Frontline Management AS), that owns and operates one of the world's largest fleets of crude oil and product tankers, VLCCs, Suezmaxes and LR2s, chartered to oil majors and traders. Controlled by John Fredriksen's interests, it is listed on the NYSE and Oslo Bors (FRO). B2B with no consumer brand profile.

GeoPark is a Latin American independent oil and gas explorer and producer with assets in Colombia (its core), Argentina, Ecuador, Peru and Brazil, producing around 30,000 to 40,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day. Customers are refiners and traders. Registered in Bermuda, with executive offices in Bogota and Santiago, and listed on the NYSE (GPRK). B2B with no consumer profile.

Global Power Generation, per Crunchbase, is an electricity generation business based in Canberra, Australian Capital Territory, in the energy and renewable energy sectors. It has funding of about A$2.3 billion. The input does not state who owns it or what projects it has, and there are other companies with similar names. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Venture Global is a US liquefied natural gas producer, based in Arlington, Virginia, that operates Calcasieu Pass and Plaquemines LNG export plants in Louisiana, selling LNG to buyers in Europe and Asia under long-term contracts. Founded in 2013, it listed on the NYSE (VG) in January 2025. Customers are utilities and energy traders. B2B with no consumer profile.

AdaptHealth is a US provider of home medical equipment and supplies, including sleep apnea (CPAP), diabetes, mobility and respiratory products, based in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, serving millions of patients in all 50 states through insurance reimbursement. Revenue is about $3 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (AHCO). Healthcare B2B2C with local consumer visibility only.

Akamai is a US cloud and cybersecurity company, based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, whose content delivery network and edge platform delivers and secures traffic for most of the world's large websites and streamers, plus a growing cloud computing arm through Linode. Revenue is about $4 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (AKAM). Customers are enterprises. B2B with low consumer awareness.

Cencora, formerly AmerisourceBergen, is a US pharmaceutical distributor and health services company, based in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania, supplying drugs and specialty products to pharmacies, hospitals and manufacturers, with revenue of more than $290 billion. Listed on the NYSE (COR). Customers are providers and drug makers. B2B, with low consumer profile.

Cipher Mining is a US bitcoin miner and data centre developer, based in New York, with industrial-scale mining facilities in Texas, and a pivot to AI and high-performance computing hosting, including hosting deals with AI cloud firms. Listed on Nasdaq (CIFR). Customers are the bitcoin network and AI cloud customers. B2B and investor-focused, low consumer profile.

Cleveland-Cliffs is the largest US flat-rolled steel producer and a major iron ore pellet maker, based in Cleveland, Ohio, supplying automotive, appliance, infrastructure and construction customers, with many US mills after buying AK Steel and ArcelorMittal USA. Revenue is about $19 billion. Listed on the NYSE (CLF). B2B industrial brand with no consumer profile.

Devoted Health is a US Medicare Advantage health plan for seniors, based in Waltham, Massachusetts, founded in 2017, offering plans in a number of states with concierge-like support, a care team and a local clinic network. Raised about $3.8 billion and has been valued at over $12 billion. Consumers over 65 are the customers. A growing health brand.

Enbridge is a Canadian energy infrastructure company, based in Calgary, operating crude oil pipelines (Mainline), natural gas transmission and utilities (Enbridge Gas Ontario), and renewables, and it moves around 30% of North America's crude. Revenue is about C$50 billion. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (ENB). B2B and utility, with consumer visibility in Ontario gas.

GFL Environmental is a Canadian waste management and environmental services company, based in Vaughan, Ontario, providing solid waste collection, landfills, recycling and soil remediation to municipal, commercial and residential customers in Canada and the US. Founded by Patrick Dovigi in 2007, with revenue of about C$7 billion. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (GFL). Mainly B2B and municipal with local consumer exposure.

Hudbay Minerals is a Canadian diversified mining company, based in Toronto, producing copper, gold, zinc and silver from mines in Peru (Constancia), Manitoba and Arizona's Copper World project. Customers are smelters and traders. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (HBM). B2B with no consumer profile.

Innergex Renewable Energy is a Canadian independent power producer, based in Longueuil, Quebec, with hydro, wind, solar and storage in Canada, the US, France and Chile, selling power to utilities under long-term contracts. CDPQ acquired it in 2025 in a deal valuing it at about C$10 billion. B2B with low consumer profile.

Ivanhoe Mines is a Canadian mining company, based in Vancouver, developing and operating major African mines: the Kamoa-Kakula copper complex and Platreef platinum-group metals in South Africa, plus the Kipushi zinc mine in DR Congo. Founded by Robert Friedland. Listed on the TSX (IVN). Customers are smelters and traders. B2B with no consumer profile.

KAFD is the King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh, a Public Investment Fund-owned mixed-use business district of towers, with offices for banks and companies, residential, retail and a metro station, being developed by KAFD Development and Management. Customers are tenants, residents and visitors. It is a landmark Saudi urban project. Government-linked with strong Saudi visibility.

Lithium Americas is a Canadian lithium developer, based in Vancouver, building the Thacker Pass lithium project in Nevada, which has a US Department of Energy loan and General Motors as strategic investor and offtaker. The US government took a stake in 2025. Customers will be battery makers. B2B development-stage company with no consumer profile.

Live Nation Entertainment is the world's largest live entertainment company, based in Beverly Hills, California, combining concert promotion, the Ticketmaster ticketing platform, venues (House of Blues) and artist management with sponsorship sales. It sells hundreds of millions of tickets across 40-plus countries and has revenue of about $23 billion. Listed on the NYSE (LYV). Facing a US antitrust case. Very high consumer brand visibility.

Lundin Mining is a Canadian base metals miner, based in Vancouver, operating copper, zinc, gold and nickel mines in Chile (Candelaria, Caserones), Brazil (Chapada), Portugal (Neves-Corvo), Sweden (Zinkgruvan) and the US (Eagle). Listed on the TSX (LUN). Customers are smelters and traders. B2B with no consumer profile.

Martin Marietta Materials is a US supplier of aggregates (crushed stone, sand and gravel), cement and asphalt for roads, buildings and infrastructure, with revenue of about $6.5 billion. Based in Raleigh, North Carolina, and listed on the NYSE (MLM). Customers are contractors and government agencies. B2B, no consumer visibility.

Matador Resources is a US independent oil and natural gas company, based in Dallas, Texas, focused on the Delaware Basin in southeast New Mexico and West Texas, plus midstream assets through San Mateo. Listed on the NYSE (MTDR), with revenue of about $3.5 billion. Customers are refiners and marketers. B2B with no consumer profile.

McKesson Medical-Surgical is a US distributor of medical supplies, equipment and pharmaceuticals to physician offices, surgery centres, home care and long-term care providers, based in Irving, Texas, and a segment of McKesson Corporation (NYSE: MCK). Customers are non-hospital healthcare providers. B2B with no consumer profile.

Medical Properties Trust is a US real estate investment trust, based in Birmingham, Alabama, owning hospitals and healthcare facilities leased to operators such as Prospect Medical and Steward, with properties in the US, UK, Germany, Spain and elsewhere. Its main tenants had financial trouble in 2024-25. Listed on the NYSE (MPW). B2B landlord with no consumer profile.

Newmont is the world's largest gold mining company, headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with mines in the US, Canada, Mexico, Ghana, Australia, Peru and Argentina, and copper, silver and zinc by-products. Revenue is about $19 billion. It acquired Newcrest in 2023. Listed on the NYSE (NEM) and other exchanges. B2B with little consumer visibility.

Nippon Steel is Japan's largest steelmaker, based in Tokyo, producing steel for cars, construction and energy, with operations in Japan, India, Southeast Asia and the US, and revenue of about 8 trillion yen. It acquired US Steel in June 2025 for about $14.9 billion, following a long political fight. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (5401). B2B with little consumer profile.
